item.title: whoami
item.description:
I am KK—a system builder bridging hardware and software. Electrical engineer by training, software engineer by trade, with an education in wireless communications and a career in building distributed systems for wired networking.

My full name is Kok-Kiong Yap. My Chinese name is 叶国强 (Ye Guoqiang in Mandarin Pinyin), but as a Singaporean, my official English name reflects the traditional Hokkien pronunciation.
